name: Arbitrary Direction Mesh Slicing
definition: A method to generate slices along any user-defined direction by intersecting mesh edges with a plane, allowing for unlimited cross-sections for training data collection.
summary: Arbitrary Direction Mesh Slicing generates cross-sectional slices from a 3D surface mesh by intersecting edges with a user-defined plane, enabling visualization of oblique structures that standard axial, coronal, or sagittal slicing might overlook.
